safetyRule: No business identity, redirect target or public facts are fabricated. A 410 remains only when no stable entity or equivalent destination can be recovered.
publicInactiveRule: Recovered inactive businesses retain an indexable canonical page containing identity, location, description and archived media only. Phone, WhatsApp, booking, offers, price and availability are excluded by an explicit public projection.
reactivationRule: An accepted active supplier generation overrides both the runtime archive and the bundled historical archive. The same canonical URL resumes the active business page without a redirect or SEO reset.
